run.label_policy: Unmodified publisher JSON. Decimal comparisons exact. No label fitting or test-time training.
run.pdf_wrapper: Original image embedded in a neutral PDF at 200 DPI without deliberate resampling or augmentation; actual application OCR renders at 200 DPI.
run.prediction_input: PDF bytes only; source IDs, metadata, gold and filenames never passed to extractor
run.line_alignment: Hungarian description-only similarity >= 0.65; row correctness still requires exact normalized description and numeric fields. No price/quantity alignment.

dataset.attribution: Divya52, Indian GST invoices (synthetic), Hugging Face; publisher-generated labels retained unchanged.
dataset.selection: All 197 synthetic rows whose split column is test; all 24 injection and 40 regional rows as separate robustness suites.
dataset.hf_split_note: The Hugging Face loader calls all rows train; source split column controls selection.

limitations: Synthetic invoices, four source layouts and 25-product source catalog
Publisher labels are not independently human audited by this project
Invoice images alone provide no verified PO ledger, approval history, or same-product retrieval labels
Regional Hindi/Kannada and some units/tax structures exceed current automatic application scope
Some metadata/sample labels were inspected during dataset discovery; no model-output-guided selection or tuning
No real-invoice population or future precision guarantee
This is an extraction evaluation, not accept/reject accuracy or invoice automation
Original parser and source-quality policy are fixed before scoring; no fine-tuning or test-guided fixes
Scalar aggregate tax is not manufactured from separate components as an extraction target
Publisher zero/null fields may need visibility audit; strict source labels retained
Exact full-row comparison targets NET taxable_value, not gross total; unsupported row fields are reported separately
Raw and source-verified tracks measure the cost of abstention; verified coverage is not automation
Auxiliary injection/regional scores do not mix into primary English synthetic test metrics
